insurer: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Annual Sum Insured as per Policy Schedule (not provided in extract)

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: We will reset up to 100% of the Annual Sum Insured, Once for same illness/disease/injury and Unlimited times for different illness/disease/injury for the same Insured Person in a Policy Year
great.explanation: Up to 100% of the Annual Sum Insured is restored once for the same illness and unlimited times for different illnesses in the same policy year. This reduces the risk of running out of cover after one big claim.

great.name: Loyalty Bonus
great.quote: We will provide a Loyalty Bonus of 20% of expiring or renewed Annual Sum Insured (whichever is lower) at the end of each Policy Year... If the Insured Persons in the expiring Policy are covered on an individual basis... In the event of Claim... the credited Loyalty Bonus will not be reduced.
great.explanation: A 20% Loyalty Bonus is added at the end of each policy year (based on expiring or renewed Annual Sum Insured, whichever is lower) and it is not reduced even if you make a claim. This gives you extra sum insured growth without losing it after claims.

good.name: Modern Treatments
good.quote: We will cover the Medical Expenses... for the below mentioned Technological advancements and Treatments... Robotic surgeries, Stem cell therapy: Hematopoietic stem cells for bone marrow transplant..., Deep Brain stimulation... Bronchical Thermoplasty, IONM
good.explanation: Medical expenses are covered for listed modern treatments like robotic surgeries, hematopoietic stem cell therapy for bone marrow transplant, deep brain stimulation, bronchial thermoplasty and IONM. This improves access to newer procedures that are sometimes restricted in basic plans.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED)... shall be excluded until the expiry of 12/24 months (as per the plan opted) of continuous coverage
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are not covered until 12 or 24 months of continuous coverage, depending on the plan chosen. This is a common waiting period range in retail health insurance.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.explanation: Listed specific conditions/surgeries are not covered for the first 24 months of continuous coverage. This is a standard specific-disease waiting period.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered in the first 30 days from the first policy start date, except for accidents. This is the usual initial waiting period in health insurance.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: We will cover the Medical Expenses incurred in respect of the Domiciliary Hospitalization... provided that: i. The Domiciliary Hospitalization continues for at least 3 consecutive days
good.explanation: Home treatment is covered as domiciliary hospitalization if it continues for at least 3 consecutive days (subject to the section conditions). This can help when hospital admission is not possible or advisable.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: We will cover the expenses incurred on Air Ambulance services up to the Annual Sum Insured... It is for a life threatening emergency health conditions... Domestic Road Ambulance services cannot be provided.
good.explanation: Air ambulance expenses are covered up to the Annual Sum Insured for life-threatening emergencies when domestic road ambulance services cannot be provided. This can be valuable for critical transfers but is restricted to specific emergency situations.

good.name: Optional Covers
good.quote: Optional Covers available under the Policy: ... Maternity Cover & New Born Baby Cover ... Super Loyalty Bonus ... Sum Insured Protector ... Claim Protector ... Worldwide Cover
good.reference: Policy Schedule section a.IX (Page 4) and Section d.B (Pages 27-37)
good.explanation: Optional covers like Maternity & New Born Baby Cover, Super Loyalty Bonus, Sum Insured Protector, Claim Protector and Worldwide Cover are available for an extra premium. This lets you customize the policy based on your needs.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: medicines, drugs and consumables (other than those specified in the list of excluded expenses (non-medical) in Annexure I)
bad.reference: Section d.A.1(v) (Page 13) and Non Payables List (Pages 47-51)
bad.explanation: Consumables are only covered except for items listed as excluded (non-medical) in Annexure I, which typically includes many common hospital consumables. This can lead to out-of-pocket costs for items like gloves, syringes and other non-payables.

bad.name: Claim Intimation
bad.quote: The above information needs to be provided... within 10 days of Hospitalisation, failing which We will have the right to treat the Claim as inadmissible, as We may deem fit at Our sole discretion.
bad.explanation: Claim information must be provided within 10 days of hospitalization, failing which the insurer may treat the claim as inadmissible at its sole discretion. This is a strict condition that can risk rejection if you miss timelines.

bad.name: Home Care Approval
bad.quote: Prior approval from Us has been taken... In case the Insured Person breaches the conditions of approval or fails to take the prior written approval from Company, we are not liable to settle any claim under this section.
bad.explanation: Prior written approval is required for home care, and breach of approval conditions or not taking approval makes the insurer not liable under this section. This can make home-care claims harder to use in urgent situations.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-Payment means a cost sharing requirement... the policyholder/insured will bear a specified percentage of the admissible claims amount.
bad.reference: Definitions (Page 7) and Exclusions intro (Page 37): "...or Co-payment amount, if applicable and as specifically defined in the Policy Schedule"
bad.explanation: A co-payment may apply “as specifically defined in the Policy Schedule,” meaning you could be required to bear a percentage of each admissible claim. Any co-pay increases your out-of-pocket share on every claim where it applies.

unclear.name: Room Rent
unclear.quote: We will cover... i. Room Rent charges
unclear.explanation: Room rent is covered, but the eligible room category/limit is not stated in the quoted wording. If the schedule applies a cap, it can increase your costs and may trigger proportionate deductions.

unclear.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
unclear.quote: We will cover the Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses... up to the limits as specified in the Policy Schedule
unclear.explanation: Pre-hospitalization expenses are covered, but the number of days/limits are only stated in the Policy Schedule. Your out-of-pocket costs will depend on the schedule limits for diagnostics and consultations before admission.

unclear.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
unclear.quote: We will cover the Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses... up to the limits as specified in the Policy Schedule
unclear.explanation: Post-hospitalization expenses are covered, but the number of days/limits are only stated in the Policy Schedule. This matters because follow-up medicines and tests after discharge can be significant.

unclear.name: Cashless Process
unclear.quote: We will respond within 1 hours of the actual receipt of such pre authorization request... grant final authorization within three hours of the receipt of discharge authorization request from the hospital.
unclear.explanation: The insurer states timelines of 1 hour for responding to pre-authorization and 3 hours for final discharge authorization after receiving the hospital request. These are service timelines and do not confirm the size of the cashless hospital network or guarantee approval.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
